figurative_meaning_en: Paper that has not been written on; unwritten or blank
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মনটা একটা কোরা কাগজের মতো পরিষ্কার।
example_sentences_in_english: His mind is like a blank sheet of paper, pure and untainted.
This project is still a blank sheet, untouched.
note: Refers to the traditional use of paper in Bengali writing and documentation culture.
